specification.objective: Keep archived sessions out of the Prisma Tagged sessions board, including when an archived session retains a tag assignment.

requirements.statement: Archived session details are never rendered as tagged session cards.

Tagged assignments without returned active session details are not rendered as unavailable cards, because the SDK omits archived sessions and does not let plugins distinguish those from other unresolved assignments.
Matching non-archived tagged sessions remain visible and existing profile/tag filtering and session actions remain unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A regression test proves explicitly archived session details and unresolved tagged assignments are absent from the board while a matching active tagged session remains visible.

invariants.statement: Tag assignments and session metadata are not mutated merely because a session is archived or unavailable.
Only the Prisma plugin, its focused tests, and corresponding README description change.

forbidden_states.statement: An archived session or unverified assignment appears as a card or unavailable entry on the Tagged sessions board.
Filtering changes tag assignments, colors, session metadata, or unrelated plugin behavior.

inputs.statement: The session archived flag returned in session details, when present.
The public SDK's active-only persisted-session results and Prisma tag assignments.

outputs.statement: A Tagged sessions board containing verified active tagged sessions only.

failure_semantics.statement: The regression test fails if archived or unresolved tagged assignments appear on the board.

baseline_output_contains: archived and unresolved tagged sessions are hidden from the board
